name: Kokoro TTS
tagline: Kokoro is a lightweight open-source text-to-speech model known for producing natural, high-quality speech that punches well above its model size. At under 100M parameters it runs efficiently on consumer hardware, making it the go-to choice for developers who want local TTS without cloud API costs. It supports multiple voices and has been widely adopted in the open-source AI community.
